title: Creator Economy & Gig Work 🚀
description: YouTube, Instagram, Fiverr, Upwork, Brand Deals, and Cross-Border Payments (PayPal, Wise, Stripe).

cards.title: Cross-Border Payment Methods 💸
cards.content:
International clients se payment lene ke options:

1. **Wise**: Lowest conversion fees (~0.5-1%), fast transfer.
2. **PayPal**: Easy setup, HIGH fee (4-7% loss in forex markup + fee).
3. **Direct Wire Transfer (SWIFT)**: ₹500+ fixed charge + bank markup.

cards.title: Brand Deal Pricing Formula 📊
cards.content:
Brand sponsored video pricing formula:

**Base Rate = (Average Views / 1,000) × ₹300 to ₹800 CPM**

Example: 10,000 views average → 10 × ₹500 = ₹5,000 per dedicated video/reel min requirement.
